cases.name: reads tone, words, colours and fonts from a short guide
untrusted: Hill Country Realty brand guide. Our voice is warm, neighbourly and plain. Say 'home', 'neighbours' and 'local'. Never say 'deal of a lifetime', 'cheap' or 'luxury'. No emojis. Sign off with 'Your neighbours at Hill Country Realty'. Colours: forest green #1F4D3A and sand #E8DCC4. Fonts: Playfair Display for headings, Inter for text. Tagline: Rooted here. Equal Housing Opportunity must appear on every ad.
cases.golden: {"tone": "warm", "use_words": ["home", "neighbours", "local"], "avoid_words": ["deal of a lifetime", "cheap", "luxury"], "emojis": false, "sign_off": "Your neighbours at Hill Country Realty", "colors": ["#1F4D3A", "#E8DCC4"], "fonts": ["Playfair Display", "Inter"], "taglines": ["Rooted here"], "disclaimer": "Equal Housing Opportunity"}
